attrs.name: description
attrs.content: A collaborative workbench for giving structure to what matters, with reviewable AI framing and room for disagreement.

children: Tell us what you care about, are trying to understand, or want to work through. We can give it structure without deciding how it must end.
Local register. Summaries reflect the last saved view; opening a matter checks its exact history. Pending counts are for all participants.

children: Saved in this browser. Personas simulate collaboration; this is not an authenticated private workspace.
Roles govern this local simulation. They do not authenticate people or make this browser a private workspace. Casey remains an observer; two contributors and a coordinator are required.
These changes become proposals. A different contributor must review the exact change before acceptance. Incorporation records a management decision, not substantive agreement.
Why are we working on this?
What is in scope, and what is outside it?
If concluding, what kind of conclusion?
A conclusion label records the outcome framing. It does not attest anyone’s consent. Archive follows conclusion and preserves its kind. Reopening preserves the history.
Only the assigned participant can propose their response. Recording an answer does not accept its claims.
References can point outside this browser. They do not grant access, verify a dependency or change the other matter.
Recorded proposal activity, in replay order. Review the exact before and after in the workbench below.
Prepare separately, then choose what to share

This is a local party-work simulation. Drafts are separated by persona and matter, but the browser owner can access every persona’s storage. Protected private areas and real participant identity require an authenticated Temple/Sourcery receiver, which is not connected.

Exact shared contribution, excluding preparation notes
Share this preview as a proposal
Sharing exposes this saved contribution to the common workbench. It still needs independent review before incorporation. Editing a preparation draft never changes an already shared proposal.
My position, agreement and acceptance of the record
Review approval accepts a change into the record. Personal statements below have separate meanings and speak only for the selected persona. Silence is not agreement.
This matter record accurately includes our differences
I agree to this possible proposal
My explanation, or reason for withdrawal
Statements bind the exact target text. Earlier or withdrawn statements remain inspectable. Agreement here records a statement; no external action or execution follows automatically.
Inspect and export a matter packet

A packet contains the shared matter, unresolved questions, evidence requests, personal statements, disputes and reproducible shared history. Separate preparation and its notes are excluded. Both parties can accept record accuracy while disputing each other’s positions.
Verified matter packet JSON — copy to export
Reproduce this packet from its history
Let AI help structure this matter
Bring your agent. Prepare a brief, inspect exactly what it contains, give it to your AI, then paste its JSON response. No model is connected automatically and nothing is sent by this app.
Brief to inspect and share with your agent
Ask for issues, contrasting possible positions and possible approaches. The agent must return the response protocol and exact brief hash shown above. Its framing remains contestable.

children: Incorporate a linked issue before proposing a position or approach about it. Older suggestions are rechecked against the current matter and still require independent review.
Linked issue · positions and approaches only

Review changes, encounters and language definitions
Propose a change. Understand it together.
Local simulation: Alice and Bob can propose, review and accept. Casey can observe. These personas are not authenticated people.
Use the encounter, journey and construct forms below. They create proposals; accepted material changes only after independent review and acceptance.
Acceptance needs a different persona’s approval of this exact content. If the accepted head changes, resubmit against it and obtain a fresh review. Original proposals and reviews remain in history.
Use lowercase letters, numbers and underscores.
Each entry reads one shared object. Fields declared local belong to its journey context.
Give a new idea a construct.
A construct defines fields, requirements, edit ownership and representation. Propose it, review its effect, and accept it together.
Name a construct. Declare text fields with shared or local ownership. Required fields cannot be empty; max limits their length.

construct Reflection

heading question

Heading and paragraph declarations select the representation. Your new construct becomes available in Create an encounter or object.
Incomplete definitions stay in the editor and are saved separately. An incompatible definition cannot replace a working construct.
Inspect the source, contracts and history
Generated views derive from the authored document. Lexical highlighting is not a validity or execution claim.
Keep, import or move your workspace
Export accepted material as source, or move the complete proposal history with exact replay. Import only into an empty board.
Import proposal history into empty board
Workspace source package or acceptance receipt
Proposal history is stored in this browser under its exact runtime version. Source imports establish an explicit baseline; history imports reproduce reviews and decisions.

The horse has a few questions. Meet the same Worldwright encounter through two different introductions. Change its shared title once, then change an introduction in just one journey.
